name: What types of home additions can Frasheski Construction build?

mainEntity.name: What types of home additions can Frasheski Construction build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction specializes in various home additions, including second-story additions, room expansions like family rooms or master suites, and accessory dwelling units (ADUs). We assess your property's existing structure and local zoning regulations in areas like Berkeley and Oakland to determine the most suitable and feasible addition type for your needs. This initial assessment helps ensure the proposed addition aligns with both your vision and local permitting requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction builds second-story additions, room expansions, and ADUs, assessing your property and local zoning for feasibility.
